name: ISO New England

CT.capacity_cost_growth_note: Zone override: capacity price flat in real terms (grows at the model's INFLATION_RATE). ISO-NE load growth is winter-driven (2026 CELT: winter 50/50 peak +2.9%/yr 2026-2035 against summer +0.7%/yr; the 90/10 winter peak passes the 50/50 summer peak by 2034), which is the upside risk; 3%/yr real is run as a sensitivity (capacity.price_growth high). PJM's 5%/yr (data-centre driven) is not used.
CT.source: ISO-NE FCA 17 (2026/2027 capability period, 1 Jun 2026 - 31 May 2027): $2.59/kW-month (Rest-of-Pool; Connecticut was not a separately priced zone). $2.59 x 12 / 1000 = $0.03108M/MW-yr.
CT.notes: Connecticut cleared at the Rest-of-Pool price in FCA 15-18 (no import-constrained zone; no Connecticut local sourcing requirement in FCA 18). FCA 18 (2027/28) $3.580/kW-month = $0.04296M/MW-yr. ARA2 2027/28 $3.935/kW-month (posted 2 Sep 2026) is a reconfiguration price, reference only. Capacity Auction Reforms (FERC accepted Phase 1, 30-31 Mar 2026): a prompt annual auction about one month before each June-May period starting 2028/29, with seasonal accreditation (Phase 2) to be filed by end-2026; whether Phase 1 also brings marginal-reliability-impact accreditation was not confirmed from the FERC order in this build (_VERIFY).

notes: Market-wide default 2.5%/yr nominal (flat real at the model's 2.5% inflation); the CT zone uses INFLATION_RATE explicitly. Capacity obligations: each load-serving entity's Capacity Load Obligation is its share of the annual coincident peak x the Installed Capacity Requirement (net of HQICC), priced at the auction clearing price.
